title: Implementing io.Writer
hints: io.Writer has one method: Write(p []byte) (n int, err error). Anything with that method can be passed to fmt.Fprintf, io.Copy and friends.
Write should pass p on to the wrapped writer, add the n it reports to the count, and return n and err unchanged. The wrapped writer may write fewer bytes than len(p), so don't count len(p).
func (c *CountingWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { n, err := c.W.Write(p); c.N += int64(n); return n, err }
